PR: ingress-shim: optionally copy specific annotation [closed; labels size/L, release-note, approved, lgtm, area/api, kind/feature, dco-signoff: yes, ok-to-test]
Some setups have a requirement to have custom-field annotation set on Certificate object: https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/issues/7523.

This commit introduces an ingress-shim option:
* --extra-certificate-annotations which sets list of annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like to resulting Certificate object
